Who I Am

About Me

Hi, I'm Pranav Pramod Shinde — a First Year Computer Engineering student at MIT Academy of Engineering, Pune. I'm drawn to the intersection of hardware and software, building real-world systems with Arduino and ESP32.

I compete in drone events as part of engineering teams, push personal projects to GitHub, and have completed structured embedded systems courses on Udemy — all while still in my first year.

Outside academics, I lead a team in a network management business, generating over Rs.75,000 in turnover. I believe in building things that work in the real world, not just on paper.
